## Location

Link the affected file, heading, diagram, or command.

## Problem

Describe what is missing, inaccurate, stale, or unclear.

## Proposed correction

Describe the information or outcome the documentation should provide.

## Source of truth

Link the requirement, implementation, command output, or external primary source

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing documentation issues.

- [ ] Related diagrams or generated images are identified where applicable.
